image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a modern steam iron. The body is primarily white with deep blue accents on the handle and upper casing. A translucent green water tank is visible near the front. The soleplate appears metallic but is partially obscured by shadow and angle. A power cord extends from the rear right. There is text/branding on the side of the white body.
